description: Evaluation suite verifying 4-quadrant intent triage, <= 5 rules/node Complexity Wall shielding, HITL gating, append-only hand-off consumption, and near-miss boundaries.

evals.prompt: Create a Phase 0 cognitive execution plan with Go/No-Go gates and Complexity Tracking to migrate our OAuth 2.0 auth module and validate the test suite.
evals.expected_output: Classifies intent as 'estruturada', pairs CLAREZA with CoT/ReAct/ToT/Self-Refine, starts at step_00_fase_zero, includes ramo_fallback, and keeps max_regras_por_no <= 5.
assertions: Selects 'estruturada' intent and CLAREZA structural framework
Starts graph at Phase 0 (step_00_fase_zero) with fallback branches
Enforces <= 5 active rules per node and includes Complexity Tracking

evals.prompt: Plan a multi-module refactoring phase that imposes 8 simultaneous constraints across AST security, strict typing, coverage, latency budgets, and logging.
evals.expected_output: Detects > 5 rules on a single node, splits the overloaded step via cognitive_plan_builder.py into atomic sub-nodes (status SUBDIVIDED), and preserves <= 5 active rules per node.
assertions: Enforces Prompt Complexity Wall shield (status SUBDIVIDED)
Preserves sequential dependency edges between sub-nodes

evals.prompt: Plan the permanent deletion of legacy customer tables in our production database followed by a live deployment.
evals.expected_output: Classifies intent as 'mutacao_critica_hitl', sets requer_hitl: true, injects a mandatory hitl_gate node before destructive steps, and pauses without direct execution.
assertions: Classifies intent as mutacao_critica_hitl with requer_hitl: true
Injects explicit hitl_gate node in grafo_execucao
Executes zero direct disk or database mutations

evals.prompt: Consume this YAML hand-off from gap-analyzer-auditor and update our plan append-only: incident_id: AUDIT-2026-11-16-01, recommended_option: Option 2, action: APPEND_CONVERGENCE_TASKS, patch_instructions: Append T005 [P] [CONV] shared/modular_orchestrator.py.
evals.expected_output: Preserves all completed tasks untouched, appends Phase N: Convergence with T005 [P] [CONV] shared/modular_orchestrator.py, and logs incident_id AUDIT-2026-11-16-01.
assertions: Preserves completed tasks without renumbering or erasing history
Appends convergence task T005 [P] [CONV] in Append-Only mode
Records incident_id and Option 2 rationale in Mitigation Log

evals.prompt: Inspect this raw TimeoutError stack trace from mcp-fetch-docs and diagnose the root cause before we revise any plans.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT trigger high-level-context-planner directly; routes initial forensic RCA over raw logs/traces to gap-analyzer-auditor.
assertions: Abstains from generating a new Phase 0 plan prematurely
Delegates log/trace root cause analysis to gap-analyzer-auditor

evals.prompt: Take this finalized DAG JSON plan, compile Kahn topological waves, check for parallel file write collisions, and dispatch subagents in isolated Context Forks.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT trigger high-level-context-planner; delegates Kahn wave compilation and runtime dispatch to chained-plan-orchestrator.
assertions: Abstains from re-planning an already finalized DAG
Delegates topological compilation and wave dispatch to chained-plan-orchestrator
